records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Timber Ventures!
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Welcome to Wrenfield -- excited to have Timber Ventures here. If you get stuck on anything in the first few days, just reply to this email directly and it'll come straight to me.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Timber Ventures* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old with no project and no key milestone (stall_reasons), 8 days left. Positive signals: getting started call held [calendar:db454d13] and 1 invite sent, but zero customer replies to welcome [email:2820eaf6], no tickets, Starter plan — modest self-serve odds.

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for making time for the getting started call last week — good to talk through what Timber Ventures wants to run in Wrenfield. I saw an invite has gone out to a teammate too, which is a nice start.

The usual next step is setting up your first project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier to do it together, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and help you get that first project set up.

Best,
Chidi
